text:
In 2025, DoorDash maintained its dominant position as the clear market leader in the United States online food delivery sector, while regional giants continued to control international markets.

United States Market Share

The U.S. food delivery landscape remains highly consolidated, with two players controlling the vast majority of the market. Industry reports from platforms like Deliverect US break down the market share as follows:
Deliverect US

DoorDash: 67% market share. It continues to lead by expanding into grocery, alcohol, and retail delivery.
Uber Eats: 23% market share. It leverages tight integration with Uber’s ride-hailing app and urban hyper-local dominance.
Grubhub: Under 10% market share. It maintains a smaller, legacy footprint primarily localized in the Northeast.

International Regional Leaders

Globally, the market is split into distinct regional monopolies rather than a single worldwide winner:

Region
Dominant Company
Market Notes
China
Meituan & Ele.me
China remains the largest food delivery market globally, completely dominated by these two ecosystem apps.
Canada
Uber Eats (54%) & DoorDash (49%)
A highly competitive split market where many users utilize both platforms.
Southeast Asia
Grab
Holds a commanding 48% market share across major Southeast Asian countries.
India
Zomato & Swiggy
Zomato leads the pack, serving roughly 80 million monthly active users.
Europe
Just Eat Takeaway & Deliveroo
Just Eat Takeaway remains the top vendor in Western and Northern Europe.
Latin America
Rappi
Operates as a "super app" controlling over 50% of the market share in its home region.
